sources: https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=neri (Army Camp record, the data behind the nps.gov page)

values.note: 'These primitive camping areas have no drinking water or hookups, and limited restroom facilities ... There are no fees for camping.'

fees.source: NPS campgrounds API record for Army Camp, fees: cost 0.00, read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All sites are managed on a first-come, first-served basis and reservations are not accepted.' Camping limit 14 days in any 28-day period across the park's campgrounds; campers must occupy their site each night.

booking.source: NPS campgrounds API record for Army Camp (reservationInfo; numberOfSitesReservable 0, numberOfSitesFirstComeFirstServe 11; regulationsOverview 'Camping limit of no more than a total of 14 days per 28-day period in any park campground'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: NPS campgrounds API record for Army Camp (operatingHours: 'Campsites at Army Camp are open year round.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: NPS campgrounds API record for Army Camp ('no drinking water or hookups'; campsites electricalHookups 0), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 11 drive-in sites for RVs, campers and tents; small (under 25 ft) and medium (22-31.5 ft) RVs or trailers recommended, large ones not. Some sites partly shaded, others open. One accessible site.

sites.source: NPS campgrounds API record for Army Camp (description; accessibility.rvInfo 'There are no pull-through campsites', rvMaxLength 31, trailerMaxLength 31), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Composting toilets, year round. Bear-proof trash receptacles. No camp host. Reached by an unmarked dirt road off Route 41 near Prince.

facilities.source: NPS campgrounds API record for Army Camp (amenities: toilets 'Composting Toilets - year round', showers None, potableWater 'No water', dumpStation No, laundry No, campStore No, internetConnectivity No, staffOrVolunteerHostOnsite No; directionsOverview), read 2026-10-21

summary: NPS page/API: free fees confirmed (currency added); booking set to not reservable, first-come always, 14 days per 28; added year-round season, no hookups, 11 drive-in sites to 31 ft with no pull-throughs, composting toilets and no water/showers/dump. Operated by the NPS (New River Gorge). Note kept (AWH firsthand).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary agency claim): NPS says the campground 'offers both tent and RV campsites along the banks of the New River at one of its many horseshoe bends', while the entry is 'not waterfront' and AWH's note says the sites are set back in the woods and not waterfront. Not changed (AWH firsthand).
